The stretch down to the river got shorter this year. I walked on the cane, he went three steps and paused, looked back at me once, and the fog lifted slower than it used to.

When the sun came up the fog pulled back to the far bank, we sat down on the same long bench, and he rested his chin on the crosspiece of the cane.

The wind picked up on the way home and he stayed on the downwind side of the cane the whole way, without stopping once.
en.editorNote: For the walks where the human and the dog are getting old together. Pairs with early-morning photos of fog on a river.
variations: Short version: three steps and a pause for him, one cane for me, and this year our speeds finally match.
Longer version: he wouldn't lift his chin off the cane until the fog was gone, and by then the sun was on the far bank.

items.sourceNote: 莎拉照護〈活到老動到老，你家老狗運動了嗎〉建議避開高溫時段、調整散步時間，作為夏季散步節奏參考，內容為原創

zh-tw.content:
連續五天沒有風，柏油路白天燙到踩不下去，我把出門時間往前挪到天還沒亮。

牠走在我前面半個身位，每一格水溝蓋都低頭聞過，聞完就往前走。

回到家門口，牠趴上磁磚最涼的那一塊，肚子貼著地，尾巴掃兩下就停住。

下午三點多雲層終於堆起來，第一滴雨敲在鐵皮上，牠的耳朵動了一下，沒有起身。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合配夏天悶熱的散步照，也適合傳給每天算著幾點出門才不燙腳的狗主人。
variations: 短版：五天沒有風，我們把散步整個提前到天亮之前。
延伸版：雨敲在鐵皮上的第一聲，牠只動了耳朵，位置一公分都沒換。

en.content:
Five days without a breath of wind, the asphalt too hot to stand on by noon, so I moved our start time back to before sunrise.

He walked half a body length ahead of me, put his nose to every storm drain we passed, and moved on as soon as he was done.

Back at the front door he lay down on the coolest tile, belly flat against it, tail sweeping twice before it stopped.

A little after three the clouds finally stacked up, the first drop hit the metal roof, one of his ears moved, and he did not get up.
en.editorNote: For sticky midsummer walk photos. Good to send to the friend who plans the whole day around when the pavement cools down.
variations: Short version: five windless days, and our walk has moved to before the sun is up.
Longer version: first raindrop on the metal roof, one ear moved, and not an inch of him shifted.

items.sourceNote: 汪喵星球〈老狗四肢無力居家照護指南〉提到抬腳、跨越訓練等居家復健動作，作為情境細節參考，內容為原創

zh-tw.content:
這場雨從星期二下到星期五，地板一直是潮的，牠的後腳在這種濕冷裡收放得比較慢。

我把拐杖橫放在門口當一道檻，牠要多抬高一點腳才跨得過去，一天四次。

雨停那個早上出了太陽，牠自己走到門邊，前腳搭上拐杖，停三秒才抬起後腳。

隔天又下起來，那根拐杖還橫在原位，牠跨過去沒有停。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫在家幫老狗做復健的日常，也適合配連日陰雨後放晴的門口照片。
variations: 短版：拐杖橫在門口，一天四次，牠每次都自己走過來。
延伸版：出太陽那天牠停了三秒，隔天下雨反而一次就跨過去了。

en.content:
The rain ran from Tuesday to Friday, the floor stayed damp the whole time, and in that wet cold his back legs folded and unfolded slower than usual.

I laid the cane across the doorway as a low sill, so he has to lift his feet a little higher to clear it, four times a day.

The morning the rain broke there was sun, and he walked to the door on his own, set his front paws over the cane, and held for three seconds before the back legs followed.

The next day it started again, the cane was still lying where it was, and he cleared it without stopping.
en.editorNote: For at-home rehab with a senior dog. Pairs with a doorway photo on the first clear morning after days of rain.
variations: Short version: a cane across the doorway, four times a day, and he comes over on his own every time.
Longer version: on the sunny morning he held for three seconds; the next day, in the rain, he cleared it in one go.

items.sourceNote: 汪喵星球〈全台24小時動物醫院名單〉提到飼主應先記下夜間可看診醫院的聯絡方式，作為情境細節參考，內容為原創

zh-tw.content:
遛狗那個小包裡，一直放著一個零錢包，裡面的東西輪替得很慢：
- 五枚十塊硬幣，給公園那台常常卡住的飲水機
- 一張摺起來的名片，是半夜也有醫生在的那間醫院
- 一條牠吃剩的雞肉零食，硬掉了還是捨不得丟
- 兩張撿便袋，抽到剩最後一張才會想到要補
- 一把鑰匙，開的是舊家的門，一直沒拿出來
- 一小撮換季掉下來的毛，沒有人放進去，它自己在裡面
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合貼在遛狗裝備的開箱照下面，也適合用來寫「隨身帶著的東西其實都跟牠有關」。
variations: 短版：零錢包裡有五枚十塊、一張醫院名片，和一小撮沒有人放進去的毛。
延伸版：那把鑰匙開的是舊家的門，我們一起走過那條路，所以我沒把它拿掉。

en.content:
The bag I take on walks has a coin purse in it, and what's inside turns over very slowly:
- five ten-dollar coins, for the water fountain at the park that keeps jamming
- a folded business card from the clinic where a vet is on duty at night
- one chicken strip he left unfinished, hard as wood now, still not thrown out
- two poop bags, which I only remember to restock when one is left
- a key to the door of the apartment we moved out of, never taken off the ring
- a small clump of shedding fur that nobody put in there
en.editorNote: Pairs with a photo of your walking gear laid out. Good for the idea that everything you carry has quietly become about the dog.
variations: Short version: ten-dollar coins, a clinic card, and a clump of fur nobody put in there.
Longer version: the key opens a door we don't use anymore, but we walked that road together, so it stays.

items.sourceNote: SofyDOG〈動物醫院收費標準怎麼算〉說明掛號費與診療費的計算方式，作為情境細節參考，內容為原創

zh-tw.content:
打預防針那天出門前，我會把零錢包重新塞一次：
- 三張一百，付掛號費的時候不用等找錢
- 抄著晶片號碼的便條紙，抄了兩遍才敢收進去
- 一小顆牛肉丁，針扎下去那一秒剛好塞得進牠嘴裡
- 上次結帳那張紙摺成四折，我想比對今年漲了多少
- 剪下來的一小塊毛巾角，上面還有家裡的味道
- 回程的公車錢，這格從來沒動過，我們每次都用走的
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫帶狗打預防針的日常，也適合配動物醫院門口的照片。
variations: 短版：零錢包裡有三張一百、一顆牛肉丁，和一小塊有家裡味道的毛巾角。
延伸版：回程的公車錢從來沒動過，因為牠打完針還是想自己走回家。

en.content:
The morning of his vaccination, I repack the coin purse:
- three hundred-dollar bills, so I'm not waiting on change when I pay
- a note with his microchip number, copied out twice before I trusted it
- one small cube of beef, sized to fit in his mouth the second the needle goes in
- last year's paid slip folded in four, so I can see how much it went up
- a corner cut from his towel, still smelling like the apartment
- bus fare home, in a pocket I've never opened, because we always walk
en.editorNote: For a routine vaccination trip. Pairs with a photo taken outside the clinic door.
variations: Short version: three bills, one cube of beef, and a scrap of towel that smells like home.
Longer version: the bus fare has never been touched, because even after the needle he wants to walk home.

items.sourceNote: ETtoday寵物雲報導狗狗誤食玉米梗手術取出、另有犬隻胃裡取出數百元硬幣的案例，作為情境細節參考，內容為原創

zh-tw.content:
這半年從牠嘴裡挖出來的東西，我還記得的有這些：
- 一枚五塊，在 X 光片上亮得像顆小星星
- 半截筆蓋，咬出兩排牙印才願意吐
- 拖鞋上掉下來的塑膠頭，另外一半我到現在還沒找到
- 一段玉米梗，牠吞得很快，我追在後面喊得很大聲
- 一片乾掉的樹葉，含著走完整條巷子才鬆口
- 我的襪子，洗過三次還是被牠先叼走
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫給家裡有「什麼都想吃看看」的狗，也適合提醒新手飼主收好小東西。
variations: 短版：一枚五塊在 X 光片上亮得像顆小星星，那是這半年最貴的一次驚喜。
延伸版：獸醫看片子的時候先笑，然後說你回家把地上淨空，我照做了三天。

en.content:
Things I have pulled out of his mouth in the past six months, the ones I still remember:
- a five-dollar coin, bright as a little star on the X-ray
- half a pen cap, two rows of tooth marks before he agreed to drop it
- the plastic tip off a slipper, and I still haven't found the other one
- a piece of corn cob, swallowed fast, with me shouting behind him
- a dried leaf he carried in his mouth for a whole block before letting go
- my sock, washed three times, and still the first thing he grabs
en.editorNote: For the dog who wants to taste everything. Also a gentle reminder to new owners to pick small things up off the floor.
variations: Short version: a five-dollar coin, bright as a little star on the X-ray, the most expensive surprise of the year.
Longer version: the vet laughed at the film first, then told me to clear the floor, and I did for three days.

items.sourceNote: 汪喵星球〈貓狗吃到異物怎麼辦〉提到拖鞋、衣物等家中物品是犬隻最常叼走啃咬的東西，作為情境細節參考，內容為原創

zh-tw.content:
家裡有一份沒寫下來的清單，是牠認定屬於自己的東西：
- 沙發最右邊那塊坐墊，已經凹成牠的形狀
- 我那件洗到起毛球的外套，摺好放地上就變成牠的床
- 玄關那雙室內拖，只有右腳那一隻
- 冰箱門一開，就得分給牠的那一小口
- 我講電話時空出來的那隻手，要放在牠背上
- 傍晚那段時間，誰約我都沒有用
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫狗在家裡默默劃下的地盤，也適合配牠佔著沙發不走的照片。
variations: 短版：沙發最右邊那塊坐墊已經凹成牠的形狀，我坐上去也只是暫時的。
延伸版：那雙室內拖只剩右腳，左腳的下落至今是個謎，牠也不打算說。

en.content:
There's an unwritten list in this apartment of things he has decided are his:
- the cushion at the far right of the couch, worn into his shape
- my old pilled jacket, which becomes a bed the moment it's folded on the floor
- one house slipper by the entry, the right one only
- the bite he is owed every time the fridge door opens
- whichever hand is free while I'm on the phone, which goes on his back
- that stretch of the early evening, when no invitation can move me
en.editorNote: For the territory a dog quietly claims at home. Pairs with a photo of him refusing to give up the couch.
variations: Short version: the right end of the couch is worn into his shape, and I'm only borrowing it.
Longer version: only the right slipper is left; nobody knows where the other went, and he isn't telling.

items.sourceNote: HeroMama〈狗狗一天吃幾克才剛好〉提到一般湯匙一大匙約十五克、可用湯匙估算餵食份量，作為情境細節參考，內容為原創

zh-tw.content:
每天晚上餵飯，我會把飼料匙抹平三次，多出來的那幾顆用手指撥回袋子裡。牠站在旁邊看，我會跟牠說明這幾顆下禮拜會還給牠。
有一次多的那幾顆掉到地上，我蹲著找了很久，找到兩顆，剩下那顆牠已經吃掉了，這個月的帳我就當先平了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫餵飯前那套只有自己看得懂的規矩，也適合配狗狗坐在飼料袋旁邊等的照片。
variations: 短版：飼料匙抹平三次，多的那幾顆用手指撥回袋子裡，牠在旁邊全程監督。
延伸版：掉到地上那幾顆我找回兩顆，剩下那顆牠先吃掉了，這個月的帳我當它平了。

en.content:
Every night I level the scoop off three times, and the extra pieces go back in the bag one at a time. He stands there watching, and I tell him he'll get those back next week.
One night the extras went on the floor and I crouched there a long time looking. Two came back, the third was already gone, so I called us even for the month.
en.editorNote: For the private rules you invented around feeding time. Pairs with a photo of the dog parked beside the food bag.
variations: Short version: three level scrapes of the scoop, extras returned by hand, supervised from start to finish.
Longer version: two of the fallen pieces came back, the last one did not, and the month was declared even.

items.sourceNote: 蝦皮購物部落格〈飼料保存防潮看這篇〉提到用密封小罐分裝日常份量、減少開封主袋次數，作為情境細節參考，內容為原創

zh-tw.content:
為了不讓牠提早二十分鐘開始叫，我發展出一套拿飼料匙的動作：先假裝去倒水，順手把匙子夾在手臂內側帶出來。
昨天做到一半我才想起來，牠從四點就守在門邊了，根本不用看我怎麼拿。我還是把整套動作做完，因為都練到這麼順了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫飼主偷偷摸摸準備開飯的橋段，也適合配狗狗提早蹲在餐碗旁的照片。
variations: 短版：我發明了一套無聲取匙法，牠四點就守在門邊，這套法子從來沒派上用場。
延伸版：整套動作我還是做完了，練了這麼久，總不能因為被看穿就不練。

en.content:
To keep him from starting twenty minutes early, I worked out a way to get the food scoop out: pretend to go fill the water, then walk off with it tucked against my arm.
Yesterday, halfway through, I remembered he had been posted at the door since four and never needed to see my hands. I finished the routine anyway, because I have it down cold.
en.editorNote: For the sneaking around that goes into starting dinner. Pairs with a photo of a dog already sitting by the bowl.
variations: Short version: I invented a silent scoop retrieval. He waits at the door from four, so it has never once been needed.
Longer version: I ran the whole routine anyway; you don't drop a technique just because it got seen through.

items.sourceNote: hapet〈毛孩該吃多少才不會太多或太少〉說明狗貓每日熱量與份量需視個體調整，作為情境細節參考，內容為原創

zh-tw.content:
鞋子還沒穿好，我就蹲下來跟牠報告今天的行程，幾點開會、幾點吃飯、大概幾點回來。
牠聽不懂，這件事我很清楚，我還是會把要去哪一區、順不順路買雞肉都講一遍。
有一天趕時間沒講，走到樓梯轉角又折回去補講完，那天我遲到了十一分鐘。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫出門前那段沒有人要求的交代，也適合配狗狗坐在玄關看著你的照片。
variations: 短版：牠聽不懂，我還是每天報一次行程，連順不順路買雞肉都會講。
延伸版：趕時間那天我沒講，走到一半又折回去補完，代價是遲到十一分鐘。

en.content:
Shoes still half on, I crouch down and brief him on the day: when the meeting is, when I'll eat, roughly when I'm back.
He does not understand a word, I'm clear on that, and I still tell him which district I'll be in and whether I'll pass the chicken place.
One morning I was running late and skipped it, then turned back at the stairwell landing to finish, which cost me eleven minutes.
en.editorNote: For the send-off nobody asked for. Pairs with a photo of a dog sitting in the entryway watching you go.
variations: Short version: he understands none of it, and I still run through the whole day, chicken stop included.
Longer version: the morning I skipped it, I turned back halfway to finish, and it cost me eleven minutes.

items.sourceNote: udn寵物部落〈狗狗飼料還在憑感覺隨便倒〉介紹體重乘係數換算每日熱量、零食應計入總量，作為情境細節參考，內容為原創

zh-tw.content:
牠的每日熱量我是用計算機按的，體重乘三十，再乘一個係數，答案抄在冰箱門那張紙上。
下午多給了半條雞肉乾，晚餐我就會往下扣，扣掉的份量大概是六顆。
有人問我有沒有必要算到這麼細，我說有，然後回家繼續數那六顆。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫算熱量算到有點入迷的飼主，也適合配零食袋跟計算機同框的照片。
variations: 短版：熱量我是按計算機算的，下午那半條雞肉乾要從晚餐扣，大概扣六顆。
延伸版：有人問我算這麼細做什麼，我說沒什麼，回家還是把那六顆數完。

en.content:
I do his daily calories on a calculator: body weight times thirty, times a factor, and the answer goes on the paper taped to the fridge.
If half a chicken strip happens in the afternoon, dinner comes down, and the amount it comes down by is about six pieces.
Someone asked whether it really needs to be this exact, I said it does, then went home and counted out the six.
en.editorNote: For the owner who got a little absorbed in calorie math. Pairs with a photo of the treat bag next to a calculator.
variations: Short version: the calories go through a calculator, and an afternoon treat costs dinner about six pieces.
Longer version: someone asked why I bother, I said no reason, then went home and counted the six anyway.

items.sourceNote: 寵物百科〈帶狗狗海邊戲水 10裝備7注意事項〉提到牽繩、遮蔭與海水鹽分沖洗等外出細節，作為情境參考，內容為原創

zh-tw.content:
天還沒亮你就把釣竿架插進沙裡，牠在旁邊踩出一圈又一圈的腳印。
浮標動的時候你伸手，牠比你更快站起來，尾巴掃到你的水桶。
整個上午你什麼都沒釣到，回程車上你聞到牠身上全是海的味道。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫空手而回卻不算白跑的那種海邊清晨，也適合配狗狗在沙灘上跟著人跑的照片。
variations: 短版：釣竿架插進沙裡，牠在旁邊踩出一圈又一圈的腳印。
延伸版：一整個上午你什麼都沒釣到，車上只有牠身上那股海的味道。

en.content:
Before it gets light you push the rod holder into the sand, and he stamps ring after ring of prints beside it.
When the float dips you reach out, he is up faster than you are, and his tail sweeps into your bucket.
You land nothing all morning, and on the drive back you can smell the whole sea on his coat.
en.editorNote: For a seaside morning that comes home empty and still counts. Pairs with a photo of a dog running the sand beside you.
variations: Short version: the rod holder goes into the sand, and he stamps ring after ring of prints beside it.
Longer version: nothing bites all morning, and the ride home smells entirely of the sea on his coat.

items.sourceNote: 全國動物醫院〈海邊戲水必注意〉建議為狗狗準備遮蔽與陰涼處、避免長時間曝曬，作為情境參考，內容為原創

zh-tw.content:
牠先聽見捲線器的聲音，然後才看見你。
你把濕毛巾鋪在釣竿架的陰影底下，牠自己走過去趴好，下巴壓在你的鞋面上。
中午太陽最烈的那兩小時，你們一起沒動。
你開始收東西，牠把耳朵抬高，要確認接下來去哪裡。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫一人一狗共用一片陰影的午後，也適合配狗狗趴在腳邊睡著的照片。
variations: 短版：牠先聽見捲線器，然後才看見你。
延伸版：你把濕毛巾鋪在陰影底下，牠走過去趴好，下巴壓在你的鞋面上。

en.content:
He hears the reel before he sees you.
You spread the wet towel in the shade of the rod holder, and he walks over on his own and settles, chin resting on your shoe.
Through the two fiercest hours of sun, neither of you moves.
You start packing up, his ears lift, and he wants to know where the two of you go next.
en.editorNote: For an afternoon where one person and one dog share a single patch of shade. Pairs with a photo of a dog asleep at your feet.
variations: Short version: he hears the reel before he sees you.
Longer version: you spread the wet towel in the shade, he settles into it, chin resting on your shoe.

items.sourceNote: 毛食嗑〈狗狗可以吃海鮮嗎〉說明魚類餵食需去刺全熟且不宜過量，作為情境細節參考，內容為原創

zh-tw.content:
冰箱裡那條魚是你帶回來的，牠從第一天就記得那個味道。
每次你拉開下層抽屜，牠的鼻子會頂進來一次，只有一次，然後退開。
你沒有餵，牠也沒有再問，只是把身體挪到抽屜前面躺平。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫狗狗守著一個不屬於牠的味道，也適合配狗狗趴在冰箱前的照片。
variations: 短版：冰箱裡那條魚是你帶回來的，牠從第一天就記得。
延伸版：你沒有餵，牠也沒有再問，把身體挪到抽屜前面躺平。

en.content:
The fish in the fridge is one you brought home, and he has had that smell filed away since day one.
Every time you pull the bottom drawer, his nose comes in once, exactly once, and then withdraws.
You never feed him any, he never asks twice, he just shifts himself around and lies flat in front of the drawer.
en.editorNote: For a dog standing guard over a smell that was never his. Pairs with a photo of a dog stretched out by the fridge.
variations: Short version: the fish in the fridge is one you brought home, and he filed the smell away on day one.
Longer version: you never feed him any, he never asks twice, he lies flat in front of the drawer instead.

items.sourceNote: 來一球叭噗〈帶狗狗去澎湖寵物友善行程〉整理帶狗出門的交通與整理細節，作為情境參考，內容為原創

zh-tw.content:
雨開始落下你才發現牠已經上車，兩隻前腳踩在副駕的椅墊上。
你把窗搖開一條縫，牠的鼻子伸出去，整條路都在聞。
到家你先幫牠擦腳，擦到一半牠自己把還沒輪到的那隻抬起來給你。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫下雨天收工回家的那段車程，也適合配狗狗把鼻子伸出車窗的照片。
variations: 短版：雨才落下，牠已經上車，兩隻前腳踩在副駕的椅墊上。
延伸版：到家你先幫牠擦腳，擦到一半牠自己把還沒輪到的那隻抬起來。

en.content:
The rain starts and only then do you notice he is already in the truck, both front paws up on the passenger cushion.
You wind the window down a crack, his nose goes out, and the entire road gets smelled.
At home you wipe his paws first, and halfway through he lifts the one whose turn has not come yet.
en.editorNote: For the drive home when the rain calls it a day. Pairs with a photo of a dog with his nose out the car window.
variations: Short version: the rain starts, he is already in the truck, front paws up on the passenger cushion.
Longer version: at home you wipe his paws first, and halfway through he lifts the one still waiting.
